description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kotawila North, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820068
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, extents, encumbrances, and other land-related particulars. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and title registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
